subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Vocabulary e.g. drive, car, bus, taxi, airplane, motorcycle, truck, fast, slow, transportation, trip, boat, travel

show.line: How do we travel? By car, bus, taxi, truck, boat or airplane!

rounds.prompt: Which one goes on the water?
rounds.praise: Yes! A boat goes on water.
Yes! The airplane is very fast.

rounds.prompt: Does it go on the road or in the sky? Sort the pictures.

hints: Think. Where does it go? Road, water or sky?
Look at the wheels and the wings.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It is a motorcycle. It has two wheels.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. Two wheels and a motor. A motorcycle!

parent_line: Can name kinds of transport in English and say where they go.
